note: Split across server (api_server bridge + REST fallback) and client (desktop UI). Both halves landed in the mega PR.

server_criteria.text: The bridge forwards permission.asked and permission.replied with the exact shared WebSocket payload.
server_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c1: forwards asked and replied with the exact permission WS payload

server_criteria.text: GET /agent-sessions/:id/pending-permissions proxies the engine using the session directory and returns only that engine session's asks.
server_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c2: GET proxies the engine in the session directory and filters by SDK session

server_criteria.text: POST /agent-sessions/:id/permissions/:permissionID/reply proxies the engine with the persisted directory and SDK session.
server_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c3: POST replies with the persisted directory and SDK session

server_criteria.text: An unmatched reply returns 404 and does not clear the pending client state.
server_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c4: POST returns 404 and preserves pending state when the engine matches nothing

client_criteria.text: permission.asked renders an approve/deny prompt in the session view.
client_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c1: exact permission.asked contract renders an actionable prompt

client_criteria.text: A session blocked on a permission shows a waiting on you badge/state clearly distinct from working.
client_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c2: permission-blocked session row says Waiting on you instead of working

client_criteria.text: Approve replies with response once or always and deny replies with response reject through POST /agent-sessions/:id/permissions/:permissionID/reply.
client_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c3: permission replies use the exact REST fallback contract

client_criteria.text: Opening a session hydrates pre-existing asks from GET /agent-sessions/:id/pending-permissions.
client_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c4: selecting a session hydrates pre-existing pending permissions

client_criteria.text: permission.replied removes the matching prompt from desktop state.
client_criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c5: exact permission.replied contract resolves the matching ask
